name: Michieda Suzuha
source:
She is an energetic girl who can get along with anyone. She has the willpower to follow through once she has made up her mind. 

Determined to help magical girls who fight alone, she receives a “Magical Dress” from a doctor who conducts research on magical girls, which scientifically gives her the power of a magical girl, giving her the ability to transform.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/suzuha.html]official site[/url]]
